notes: Settled policy: the model/effort pairs used by earlier batches, one entry per pool (gpt-6-luna replaces gpt-5.6-luna).
pools[task kind or *][profile][phase] is an ordered list of {backend, model, effort}; * applies to every task kind and must cover every profile and phase, and a task-kind key replaces single pools.

The first entry is the default. Another entry runs only when the issue has the label model:<model> or model:<model>@<effort> (implement and repair) or the batch names it in model_overrides (any phase); it must be in that pool, otherwise preflight fails. No model is ever substituted.

The profile comes from profiles.json (issue label, phase override, review floor, low-risk review, escalation). An escalation uses the escalation profile's pool for the same task kind and phase: the named entry if that pool has it, else its first entry.
